summary: Iteration 11 e2e testing of the four new features (PLAY & CHAT, MULTI-AI ROOMS, PREVIEW BUDGET GUARD, CLEAR FILTERS) against the LIVE preview URL + LIVE Firestore. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_playchat_multiai.py — 15/15 passing (persistent chat + history restore, 3-player multi-AI trivia played to completion with 3 scores, 6-player allowed, 7-player rejected 400 'at most 6', unknown AI id 400, preview budget cap [T,T,T,F] at service layer, aiBudgetExceeded surfaced, 50 games all maxPlayers=6, 70 characters). Frontend: admin login -> '/', nav 'Play & Chat' -> /play-chat, searchable grid, chat 2-way with Firestore persistence verified across a full page reload, pc-challenge -> trivia game vs Marcus completed 8/8 rounds with named scores (You 0 / Marcus 8), multi-AI room with 1 and 3 extra AIs (4-player) started and a 3-player trivia completed (You 0 / Ananya 8 / Sora 8 draw), AI Characters clear-filters + localStorage persistence + pagination verified, PlayTogether single-AI preview regression verified (preview-ai-note shown, preview-ai-budget correctly absent). No 500s, no blocked clicks, no console errors.

minor.issue: Duplicate AI ids are accepted: {gameId:'general_trivia', aiCharacterIds:['ref_marcus','ref_marcus']} returns 200 but the duplicate collapses, so the session silently seats fewer players than requested. Should 400 or de-duplicate explicitly.

ui_bugs.issue: The round reveal renders a raw JSON.stringify dump of pub.revealed to the admin (developer output in an end-user-style panel). PlayTogether's preview reveal is formatted; PlayChat should match.

No way to abandon/leave an in-flight game. 'Back to setup' (pc-game-exit) only appears after completion and does not call /api/play/sessions/{sid}/abandon, so quitting mid-game (pc-back / tab switch / reload) leaves ACTIVE orphan gameSessions in Firestore forever (I found leftover ACTIVE sessions from my own aborted run).

issues: Language options are not narrowed by the selected country, so trivially empty combinations are reachable (Brazil + Arabic -> '0 characters (of 70)'). Clear filters does recover correctly.

Preview UI still exposes only ONE AI opponent (preview-opponent-select); the multi-AI capability (aiCharacterIds) that the backend/preview_start now supports is reachable only from Play & Chat. Informational vs the 'Play Together session can seat more than one AI' requirement.

action_items: Reject or de-duplicate duplicate aiCharacterIds in POST /api/play/sessions (currently 200 with a silently smaller room).
Replace the raw JSON reveal dump in PlayChat's RevealView with the formatted reveal used in PlayTogether.
Add an abandon/leave control in PlayChat's GameRunner (and call /api/play/sessions/{sid}/abandon on exit) so quitting mid-game does not leave ACTIVE orphan sessions in Firestore.
Optional: narrow the language dropdown by the selected country on /ai-characters; optional: expose multi-AI opponents in the PlayTogether preview dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: games_service.create_session does not de-duplicate ai_ids before the maxPlayers check, so ['x','x'] passes validation and then collapses in scores/submitted.

PlayChat.jsx GameRunner unmounts without releasing the session (no abandon call) — a leak of ACTIVE sessions; also there is no polling/refetch, so a mid-game reload loses the in-progress session entirely from the UI (session state is component-local, not resumable).
PlayChat RevealView ignores its `label` prop and prints JSON — dev artifact in production UI.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed (2 medium UI/UX defects reported)

rca_of_the_issue: N/A for feature correctness — all four features work end to end. Orphan ACTIVE sessions root cause: PlayChat's GameRunner keeps session state only in React state and never calls /api/play/sessions/{sid}/abandon on unmount/exit, so any mid-game navigation leaves the Firestore session in status=active with the AI turn already consumed.
